definitions.explanation: A comprehensive report published once a year, summarizing an organization's activities, financial performance, or research findings over the past year.

examples.japanese: {年次報告|ねんじほうこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}する→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧。
⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{年次報告|ねんじほうこく}{書|しょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The company's annual report was published.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国連|こくれん}→国連：12035_kokuren⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{年次報告|ねんじほうこく}⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧、⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{増加|ぞうか}→増加：03329_zouka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: According to the UN's annual report, the world's population continues to grow.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{年次|ねんじ}→年次：15657_nenji⟧ (annual, yearly) and ⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧ (report). Common in business, government, and academic contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年次報告|ねんじほうこく}{書|しょ} — annual report (document)
- {年次報告|ねんじほうこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧ — to submit an annual report
- {年次報告|ねんじほうこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}する→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧ — to release an annual report

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {年報|ねんぽう} — annual report, yearbook (shorter synonym, also common)
- ⟦{決算報告|けっさんほうこく}→決算報告：25816_kessanhoukoku⟧ — financial report (specifically about accounts/finances)
- ⟦{年次|ねんじ}→年次：15657_nenji⟧ — annual (the base modifier)
